name: Westrock Coffee - Conway AR Single-Serve "Clark" Plant

fieldNotes.location: Identified as the large gray-roof warehouse/manufacturing building on William J. Clark Drive immediately SOUTH of the Westrock DC. This is the 525,000 sq ft 'Clark' single-serve (K-cup pod) facility — 130,000 sq ft manufacturing plus fulfillment/distribution — that Westrock opened July 2025. The shell appears in 2024 imagery (likely a Tempus-developed spec building that Westrock fitted out and occupied in 2025). The roster pin (-92.409215) sat ~350m too far west on an unrelated older trucking yard; center re-locked to the gray building at 35.0578,-92.4050.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Continuous chain-link perimeter fencing surrounds the property (clearly visible in 2024-07 Street View along the south frontage and around the yard). A sliding chain-link gate across the truck driveway is visible at the NW/SW corner where the yard connects to William J. Clark Drive. The truck yard is fully enclosed.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth positively identified. The truck entrance reads as a sliding chain-link gate with no adjacent booth — implying kiosk/remote check-in. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Truck gate present, no guard shack seen — remote check-in inferred.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long banks of dock doors with trailers backed in along BOTH the north and south long faces of the building; ~50-70 doors estimated across the two faces — banded 50+. Exact count limited by imagery scale.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Trailer-parking lanes line both long faces with ~60-80 trailers present; a dedicated drop/storage function is clear (dropArea banded 50+).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Well over 50 trailers parked along the building's two dock faces.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks run on two physically separate building faces (north face and south face) — consistent with separate ship/receive flows; marked true but uncertain since both faces could serve mixed traffic.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide perimeter loop road and deep aprons give room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep gate-to-dock approach along the perimeter loop stacks 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Paved yard inside the fence provides holding/queue room before the docks.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Conway industrial corridor near I-40 with surrounding industrial development — Urban.
fieldNotes.imagery: Building opened operationally July 2025; available satellite/Street View predates full Westrock occupancy. Structure is fully built in imagery, so layout audit is reliable; operational specifics carry medium confidence.
